notablePrerequisites: You have cast at least one instant and/or sorcery this turn.
description:
At the beginning of combat on your turn, Rionya triggers, creating at least two copies of Atsushi with haste.
Put all but the nontoken Atsushi into your graveyard due to the legend rule.
Each Atsushi token triggers, creating a total of at least six Treasure tokens.
Move to your postcombat main phase.
Activate five of the Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {3}{R}{R}.
Activate Aggravated Assault by paying {3}{R}{R}, untapping all creatures you control and getting an additional combat and main phase after this one.
Repeat.
